role: The single post-v197 physically distinct candidate contract on the already-opened complete p=22kw_size=01 development trajectory. It tests an observation-selected statistical inverse, not a new coordinate subset, another CGLS depth, validation, test, resource performance, or real BOST.
scientific_question: Can a fit-only empirical coordinate covariance and deployment-visible generalized cross-validation choose a stable full-DCT affine inverse that preserves every v197 absolute field, gradient, and observation gate after one unchanged physical CGLS step, while using one fewer exact forward and one fewer exact adjoint than the fixed full-DCT K2 reference?

data_isolation.fit_only_prior_source: the same ten complete PoolFire train-split trajectories and 1010 transformed fields frozen before v178
data_isolation.fit_truth_role: only the already-sealed affine basis and its singular values are inherited; no p22 state enters the prior
data_isolation.frame_indices: all integers 0 through 100 in immutable order
data_isolation.calibration_indices: all integers 0 through 12 in immutable order
prediction_inputs: fit-only affine center, basis, and singular values
prediction_forbidden_inputs: future p14, validation, or test data
data_isolation.prediction_barrier: all coordinates, selected tau indices, scores, stationarity, controls, hashes, and a read-set attestation are sealed before the scorer may open p22 truth

physical_distinction: v198 leaves the complete per-camera DCT observation, 1009-row fit affine field basis, sensor roster, reported geometry, and unchanged physical K1 shell fixed. Unlike v190-v195 coordinate selection and sketching, it retains every detector-potential coordinate. Unlike v159-v162 H1/Sobolev/global geometry quadratic penalties, its penalty is the fit-only empirical covariance in the affine coordinate system and its strength is chosen separately for each deployment observation by a truth-free GCV predictive-risk rule.

primary.name: empirical_covariance_gcv_full_dct_k1
primary.centered_feature: the exact v195 camera-resolved full 24x24 DCT potential feature after removing one DC coefficient per active camera and subtracting the frozen affine-center response
primary.response: H has one row per frozen affine coordinate and 575 canonical feature columns per active camera
primary.fit_prior_standard_deviation: d_i=sigma_i/sqrt(1010), using the first 1009 singular values sealed with the fit-only affine basis; multiplying every d_i by one common positive constant must leave the algorithm invariant
primary.formal_factorization: thin float64 scipy.linalg.svd of G with LAPACK gesdd
primary.independent_factorization: separately coded thin float64 scipy.linalg.svd of G with LAPACK gesvd
primary.retained_rank: retain singular values at least s_max*sqrt(float64 epsilon); require all 1009 affine directions
primary.lambda_rule: lambda=(tau*s_max)^2, where s_max is the largest singular value of G for the current reported geometry and active-camera set
primary.gcv_rule: for m canonical feature coordinates, minimize m*||h-h_hat_lambda||_2^2/(m-trace(Hat_lambda))^2 using the exact retained SVD, including the data component orthogonal to the row space
primary.tie_rule: the tau grid is ascending; among scores no more than min_score + 1e-14 + 1e-10*abs(min_score), choose the first and therefore the smallest tau
primary.final_coordinate: solve the same generalized Tikhonov system on every active camera using the selected tau, then form x0=affine_center+a affine_basis
primary.refinement: exactly one iteration of the unchanged strict v10.1 identity-preconditioned physical CGLS recurrence

blocking_and_reporting_controls.identity_gcv_full_dct_k1: repeat the identical GCV grid, tie rule, full-DCT feature and unchanged K1 using d_i=1; if it passes, generic isotropic GCV explains the result and the empirical covariance is not needed
blocking_and_reporting_controls.full_dct_k1_parent: the sealed v196 unregularized full-DCT K1 arm at the same 2A+1A^T online ledger
blocking_and_reporting_controls.zero: the literal zero field and its exact call ledger
blocking_and_reporting_controls.bp_cgls1: one exact identity-preconditioned CGLS step from zero, equivalently normalized exact backprojection
blocking_and_reporting_controls.pcgls: the v182 affine Jacobi-PCGLS1 field rebuilt on every complete-trajectory cell from the current observation and reported geometry
blocking_and_reporting_controls.dual_ridge: the independently validated v180 shared diagonal-plus-rank16 dual-ridge model, applied without refit to every complete-trajectory cell and followed by the same unchanged physical K1
blocking_and_reporting_controls.control_precedence: any control with both forward and adjoint calls no greater than the primary that passes all absolute cells and groups blocks a covariance-specific headroom claim

exact_call_and_cache_ledger.candidate_difference_from_reference: one fewer exact forward and one fewer exact adjoint per cell
exact_call_and_cache_ledger.geometry_cache: the 26 dense full-DCT response matrices, affine basis response, mean response, GCV SVDs, v180 fit model, and all setup factors are offline costs and remain in whole-pipeline accounting
exact_call_and_cache_ledger.dense_online_work: the candidate reads every 575-mode camera feature, multiplies dense SVD factors, evaluates ten GCV values, and forms a dense 1009-coordinate field
exact_call_and_cache_ledger.resource_claim: none before a separately frozen fresh-process wall and whole-pipeline RSS gate

required_validity_gates: all parent hashes, statuses, source roles, observation seals, affine arrays, fit singular values, calibrations, subsets, frame order, and inputs are unchanged
prediction code has no truth, metric, frame-index, time, trajectory-label, reference-output, validation, or test parameter and seals all prediction arrays before truth is opened

formal and independent implementations each rebuild full-DCT responses, canonical features, empirical and identity GCV coordinates, PCGLS, dual-ridge, physical K1, metrics, tails, strict masks, and call ledgers
all 1009 whitened response directions are retained; every GCV score, coordinate, field, residual, metric, stationarity value, and call receipt is finite
tau selections are identical between implementations and camera/ray permutations preserve canonical features, selections, coordinates, and fields within 1e-9 relative error
tau=0 empirical-prior coordinates reproduce the sealed unregularized full-DCT coordinate within 1e-8 relative error
formal-independent regular arrays agree within 1e-8 relative error and near-zero stationarity arrays within 1e-10 absolute error
the fixed v197 reference and its v196 source arrays remain byte-identical before and after execution
fixed_decision_order: Any binding, isolation, prediction-barrier, rank, finite, GCV, tie, stationarity, permutation, parent-reproduction, physical-replay, control, call-ledger, group-tail, seal, or independent-comparison failure makes v198 inconclusive.

If the empirical covariance GCV K1 primary fails any of 2626 strict cells or any of 26 complete groups, conclude FAIL_COVARIANCE_GCV_FULL_DCT_V198 and close this exact prior, tau grid, GCV rule, and K1 shell without tuning or a larger model.

If the primary passes but identity-GCV or another equal-or-lower exact-call control also passes every cell and group, conclude PASS_CHEAPER_CONTROL_EXPLAINS_COVARIANCE_GCV_V198 and reject covariance-specific advantage.

Only if the primary passes all cells and groups, the fixed reference remains qualified, and every equal-or-lower exact-call control fails may v198 conclude PASS_COVARIANCE_GCV_DEVELOPMENT_HEADROOM_V198.

A v198 headroom pass would authorize only a separately frozen p14 validation contract. It would not authorize test access, wall/RSS claims, GPU rental, curved-ray validity, real BOST, paper success, first/SOTA/global-uniqueness language, or algorithm breakthrough.
failure_action: A valid negative result closes empirical-covariance GCV on the complete opened p22 trajectory. Do not alter the prior, tau grid, tie rule, GCV formula, K1 depth, or thresholds; do not rescue it with CNN, FNO, UNO, DeepONet, extra exact calls, GPU training, or post-result control selection.
prior_art_boundary: Tikhonov regularization, generalized cross-validation, covariance priors, variable-sensor set processing, warm starts, and Krylov refinement are established components. No first, SOTA, global uniqueness, or component-level novelty claim is permitted.
